correctness.rationale: The exact conjugation by the positive four-periodic eigenmode produces identity (1) with strictly nonnegative gradient, boundary and damping terms. The cell Cauchy bound has equality for inverse-conductance increments and gives effective stiffness alpha=2/(S mbar), independently rechecked with exact fractions. The h=epsilon^(1/3) normalized minimizers have Dirichlet compactness, quantitative tail tightness from the damping term, and a liminf bounded below by the linear-potential quadratic form. A cellwise harmonic recovery sequence gives the matching limsup. The Dirichlet half-line Airy problem has principal eigenvalue a_Ai alpha^(1/3)L^(2/3), yielding the announced constant and 2/3 law for all fixed s,t>0. Verification code checks critical rational identities; no finite experiment is misused as proof of the infinite limit.

value.rationale: The August 2026 published family already has bounds and exact implicit determinants but no sharp spectral-edge singular limit. The result determines a nonanalytic 2/3 exponent, the exact universal Airy factor and an explicit two-parameter harmonic-resistance coefficient. These are naturally motivated invariants for the compact-to-periodic crossover, quantify the failure of ordinary Taylor expansions near q=1, and supply structure not provided by general fixed-q inequalities. It is a complete leading-order classification for all positive modulations, not an arbitrary finite-parameter calculation.
